prompt: A monochrome silverpoint character study: a single figure alone on plain off-white paper, drawn only in fine grey metalpoint lines and hatching, like a page from a Renaissance master's sketchbook. A big, blobby, bloated frog creature, only vaguely human in shape, with a huge, round, fat belly and short, stumpy legs. Its broad frog head sinks into its shoulders with no neck, and has a very wide frog mouth and big, bulging frog eyes set far apart. Its skin is warty, slimy frog skin all over. A gross, scraggly, mossy beard hangs from its chin, and stringy, scraggly hair hangs from the top of its head. Its hands are webbed frog hands with long fingers. It sits squat like a frog. Full-length figure: the whole body from head to feet inside the frame, isolated on blank paper. silverpoint study, metalpoint drawing, Renaissance sketch, hatching and cross-hatching, fine line, high contrast, sharp focus, monochrome, clean light paper ground
